|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">戦闘のはじめに、宇宙船に乗っている場合、即座に、他に1名のキャラクターを連れて、同一星系内の位置に、即座に脱出（移送）することができる。ターキンと同じ位置にいる場合、戦闘力＋１。バストが操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-165o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">グランドモフ・ターキンの副官。決して敵を過小評価しない。若い頃に親しんだ狩りによって、狡猾さと忍耐力を身に付けたのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Chief Bast.

'''Card text:''' At the start of a battle, if aboard a starship, may immediately evacuate (relocate) with one other character to a site in the same system. Power +1 if at the same site as Tarkin. A starship Bast pilots is power +2.

'''Lore:''' Aide to Grand Moff Tarkin. Never underestimates the enemy. Hunting as a youth taught cunning and patience.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese relocates to a site in the same system; the English relocates to a related site.
|notes=The preserved frame shows the Imperial and Pilot icons. Its lower edge is cropped, so it does not establish whether any additional icon is printed below the visible area.<ref name="jp-face" />
